inputs.name: a run request from the Requesting Authority's Cell, carrying the reference of an approved Design Request held in Source Lifecycle and stating how fine the model should be
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version), received through the HU input port at the tool gateway

inputs.name: the organisation's sources, by reference only, from the output socket of Source Lifecycle
inputs.format: source reference (ID + version + hash; held or not held), received through the Input socket

inputs.name: answers to needs requests, recorded and approved as sources in Source Lifecycle
returns from Process and Position Design and from Delivery and Implementation on a release of this part, under the Library's design return contract
inputs.format: Work Item (ID + version) validating against library/contracts/design-return.schema.json, received through the tool gateway

outputs.name: needs requests to the Chief of Staff of Source Lifecycle, one thing and one decision per row, with a report of what is still missing
outputs.format: Work Item sub-items (ID + version), sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: a target operating model release: capabilities, value streams, decision rights, interfaces and hand-offs, with a role register that names each role and what it decides; traced to its sources, walked, independently checked at every stage, and decided element by element by the Requesting Authority; it does not say what fills a role
outputs.format: frozen, content-addressed release (manifest + parts by hash), filed into Source Lifecycle as a source of origin kind operating model

outputs.name: a release notice to Process and Position Design for each decided release
outputs.format: release notice under the Library's release notice contract (library/contracts/release-notice.schema.json): release ID, version and manifest hash, filed reference, final-status decision and the returns it answers; sent through the tool gateway

outputs.name: the answer to each return, on the return itself: a new decided release, or the Requesting Authority's decision, including a decision to set the return aside and carry the affected elements forward on a stated basis; the rows put to that authority made by code from the return and the release
outputs.format: release reference or decision reference, recorded on the return

outputs.name: where no release can be formed, a readiness report or a held report
outputs.format: versioned record, filed into Source Lifecycle as a source of origin kind design report

tool_roles: source of record (the output socket of Source Lifecycle)
the input port of Process and Position Design (release notices out, returns in)
the output port of Delivery and Implementation (returns in, answers out)
tool gateway (signatures, metering, the stop door)
engines through the shared gateway; three or more engines from two or more families check each stage
reference models, read by version and hash, as a method only
